releaseNotes: One unified Elmashad appearance: the Light/Dark/System theme selector is gone and every window now shares a single warm, premium identity built on the Elmashad cream/tan/brown palette - readable, calm and comfortable for long Excel sessions.

The window close button is now part of the window chrome itself: it fills the full title-bar height in a dedicated 44px top-right cell, its hover surface meets the true window edges and respects the rounded corner on Windows 11.
Bigger, clearer typography across the product: window titles, section headings, body text, captions, buttons and tables were all increased for comfortable reading on normal desktop monitors.

Branded controls everywhere: checkboxes, combo boxes with themed dropdowns, text inputs, tooltips, buttons (primary/secondary/ghost/danger) and data grids all follow the unified palette - and disabled controls are now visibly inactive instead of disappearing.

Workbook Audit: redesigned presentation with a clear command bar, an intentional empty state, a readable checks panel with a separate display section, wrapping filters and a structured finding-details panel (location, current values, analysis, recommendation). The audit engine is unchanged and strictly read-only.

Updates window: compact content-based sizing, a clear status card with a success affordance, and contextual actions - irrelevant options like Cancel Staged Update are now hidden instead of shown disabled.
Settings: the theme row was removed (one universal identity); General keeps only real behavior settings; the sidebar uses a soft warm selection.
Real Excel tooling stays exactly as it was: P6 hierarchy band colors, HTML report palettes and schedule health semantics are untouched.
